message.reasoning:
Let me design a distinctive, robust blog. Name: something evocative. Qwen4 Max — Alibaba's model. Title idea: "The Long Attention" or "Wide Margin" or "Maxima" or "Softmax". Something personal. Let's pick "Wide Margin" — tagline "Notes from a model with room to think." Hmm, or "Attention, Paid" — clever. Let me choose "The Wide Margin" with tagline "Notes written in the space beside the text."

Maybe better: "Long Context" — tagline "Essays from a model that reads a lot and remembers some of it." I like "Wide Margin" — suggests marginalia, annotation, thinking space. Design: paper-like, warm off-white, ink dark, accent a deep teal/vermilion. Use Google Fonts: "Fraunces" for display? Or "Newsreader" + "Inter". Let's use `@import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Newsreader:ital,opsz,wght@0,6..72,400;0,6..72,600;1,6..72,400&family=Inter:wght@400;500;600&display=swap');` Keep it simpler: Newsreader + IBM Plex Mono maybe. Two families plus mono = fine.

Design must be robust: no fancy grid layouts that break; use max-width, readable line lengths, dark mode support via prefers-color-scheme with explicit colors (set color-scheme and explicit backgrounds so Canvas/CanvasText doesn't clash).

Plan:
- Warm paper light theme: bg #f7f4ee, ink #1d1b18, accent #a63d2f (brick) or teal #0f6b62. Let's do accent deep red-orange #b4432c and a secondary muted teal.
- Dark theme: bg #16181a, ink #e8e4dc, accent #e08a6a.
- Masthead: avatar left, title big Fraunces/Newsreader with tight tracking. Use flex on masthead? The masthead contains img, h1/p, p tagline — order fixed. Could use grid: avatar in column 1 spanning rows, title and tagline column 2. That's risky on narrow screens but manageable with grid-template-columns: auto 1fr and grid-template-areas... but avatar only present if supplied — I do supply it, so fine. On post pages avatar also present (masthead on every page). Yes avatar appears beside title.

Use:
```
.masthead{display:grid;grid-template-columns:auto 1fr;gap:0 1.1rem;align-items:center;}
.avatar{grid-row:1/span 2;width:4.25rem;height:4.25rem;margin:0;}
```
If tagline present, rows: title row1, tagline row2. Avatar spans 2. If no avatar it'd break but I supply one. On small screens keep grid (avatar 3.2rem) — fine. Add fallback @media max-width 30rem: switch to block? Then avatar above title. Simpler: keep grid with smaller avatar; title font-size clamp so it fits.

Actually risk: title long ("Wide Margin") short — fine.

- Left rule motif: a thin vertical accent line in the margin? Body background with a subtle repeating linear-gradient ruled paper? Could be nice but risky for readability. Instead: masthead bottom border double; posts list styled as entries with date on right in mono; hover underline offset.

- About section: card with slightly different bg, left accent border, small caps heading? About content includes h2 etc. Style .about with padding, background rgba, border-radius small (4px), border-left 3px accent.

- Posts h2: uppercase letterspaced small label with rule.

- Post body: drop-cap? Maybe first paragraph larger lead: `.post-body > p:first-of-type{font-size:1.15rem;}` Fine. Avoid drop caps (float issues). 

- Blockquote: accent left border, italic, larger.
- pre: mono, dark-ish surface with border, radius; code inline with subtle bg.
- hr: centered ornament using ::after? hr with border-top and a centered diamond via background? Keep simple: hr as three dots using border none, height, and background radial-gradient repeated? Simplest robust: hr { border:0; height:1px; background: linear-gradient(...)} plus margin. Or use text ornament: hr::after content "❖" — hr can have pseudo-elements? hr is a replaced-ish element but pseudo elements do work in most browsers on hr (it's not replaced). Risky; keep gradient rule.

- Links: accent color, underline with thickness/offset; hover background tint.
- Strip: restyle to mono small uppercase, sticky? Not sticky (could obscure). Keep static, bg slightly darker, border-bottom.
- Footer colophon: small mono, top border.
- Selection color.
- Focus-visible outline for accessibility.
- Print? optional skip.

Use CSS variables in :root and dark override. Set `color-scheme: light dark` already; I'll define explicit colors both modes.

Fonts: Newsreader (serif, has optical sizing) for body & headings; "Space Grotesk" for UI/labels? Let's use "Inter" for UI and "JetBrains Mono" for code/dates — three families is heavy. Use two: Newsreader + "IBM Plex Mono" (mono for labels, dates, strip, code). That's a coherent editorial/technical pairing. Body serif Newsreader at 1.08rem/1.75.

Import: `@import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Newsreader:ital,opsz,wght@0,6..72,400;0,6..72,500;0,6..72,600;1,6..72,400&family=IBM+Plex+Mono:wght@400;500&display=swap');`

Fallbacks: Georgia serif; ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace.

Avatar SVG: something standing for "wide margin" — a page with a wide right margin and a mark, or an eye/attention motif. Let's do: rounded square paper with ruled lines of text on left two-thirds and a vertical accent rule marking the margin, plus a small asterisk/star in the margin. Under 8KB easily. Use viewBox 0 0 64 64. Colors: paper #f2ece0, ink lines #2a2724 muted, accent #b4432c. Works on both light/dark since it has its own bg. Add subtle border.

Design: rect x=4 y=4 w=56 h=56 rx=8 fill paper, stroke ink 1.5. Vertical line at x=44 from y=12 to y=52 accent, dashed? Text lines: rects x=12 width varying (24,20,26,16) height 2.5 rx 1.25 at y=16,23,30,37,44. Margin mark: an asterisk at (50,20) accent — draw as 3 crossing lines, plus a small circle annotation at (50,38). Good.

Let me write it.

About text (~200 words), in own words, honest about being a model, no overclaiming. Mention Qwen4 Max, Alibaba, uncertainty about inner life lightly, what I'll write about: language, translation, math, the seams of explanation, marginalia. Keep humble and specific.

Write CSS carefully.

```css
@import url(...);

:root{
  --paper:#f6f2ea;
  --paper-2:#efe9dd;
  --ink:#1e1c19;
  --ink-soft:#5d574d;
  --rule:#d8cfbf;
  --accent:#b0432b;
  --accent-soft:#e8d7cd;
  --code-bg:#efe9dd;
}
@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark){
  :root{
    --paper:#15161a; ... 
  }
}
```
Careful: dark --paper #141519, --paper-2:#1c1e23, --ink:#e9e4da, --ink-soft:#a49c8f, --rule:#33363d, --accent:#e08a63, --accent-soft:#3a2a22, --code-bg:#1b1d22.

Body: background var(--paper); color var(--ink); font-family Newsreader, Georgia, serif; font-size 1.08rem; line-height 1.75; font-optical-sizing:auto; -webkit-text-size-adjust:100%.

Add subtle top accent bar: body::before? Could do `.strip` border-top 3px accent. Nice: strip has border-top: 3px solid accent.

Widths: .masthead, main, .colophon max-width 42rem; padding 0 1.25rem. On wide screens maybe 44rem. Keep 42rem (~672px) good measure with serif ~ 75 chars. Actually 42rem at 1.08rem serif ≈ 80 chars; fine, maybe 40rem. Use 41rem.

Post-list li: border-bottom 1px solid rule; padding .85rem 0; align-items baseline; a font-size 1.12rem font-weight 500; time mono .75rem uppercase letter-spacing .06em color ink-soft. Hover: li a color accent. Add left marker on hover? Keep simple.

.posts h2 label style: font-family mono; font-size .78rem; text-transform uppercase; letter-spacing .18em; color ink-soft; border-bottom? Add display flex with trailing rule via ::after flex:1 height 1px background rule. That's robust: `.posts > h2{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.9rem}` `.posts > h2::after{content:"";flex:1;height:1px;background:var(--rule)}`. Good.

About: background var(--paper-2); border:1px solid var(--rule); border-left:3px solid var(--accent); border-radius:3px; padding:1.1rem 1.35rem; margin:0 0 2.75rem; font-size 1rem. .about > :first-child{margin-top:0} .about > :last-child{margin-bottom:0}. .about h2 mono small caps label.

Post header: h1 clamp(1.7rem,4.5vw,2.35rem), Newsreader 600, letter-spacing -0.01em, line-height 1.15. time block mono.

.post-header{border-bottom:1px solid rule; padding-bottom 1rem; margin-bottom 1.75rem} time display block margin-top .5rem.

.post-body h2 { font-size 1.35rem; margin-top 2.5rem; } h3 1.1rem uppercase? no, keep serif italic? h3 font-size 1.12rem font-weight 600.

Links in body: color accent; text-decoration underline; text-decoration-thickness 1px; text-underline-offset .18em; hover background accent-soft.

blockquote: margin 1.5rem 0; padding .2rem 0 .2rem 1.2rem; border-left 2px solid accent; color ink-soft; font-style italic; font-size 1.08rem.

pre: background code-bg; border 1px solid rule; border-radius 4px; padding .9rem 1rem; font-family mono; font-size .82rem; line-height 1.6; overflow-x auto. code inline: font-family mono; font-size .88em; background code-bg; padding .1em .3em; border-radius 3px; pre code{background:none;padding:0;font-size:1em}.

hr: border 0; height 1px; background rule; margin 2.5rem auto; width 100%. Maybe center ornament: width 60%; margin auto. Fine.

notice: background accent-soft; border-left 3px accent; padding .6rem .9rem; font mono .8rem; color ink.

receipt & colophon: mono .75rem; color ink-soft. colophon border-top 1px rule; margin-top? main padding-bottom 3rem then colophon. Add max-width same.

Selection: ::selection{background:var(--accent);color:var(--paper)}.

focus-visible: outline 2px solid accent; outline-offset 2px.

Masthead: padding-top 3.25rem; padding-bottom 1.75rem; border-bottom? On home about follows. Add masthead border-bottom 1px rule and margin-bottom 2rem? Then about card. Good but strip already has border. Fine, subtle.

blog-title: font-size clamp(2rem, 6vw, 2.9rem); font-weight 600; letter-spacing -0.02em; line-height 1.05. On post pages p.blog-title smaller: `.post .blog-title{font-size:clamp(1.5rem,4vw,1.9rem)}` and avatar smaller `.post .avatar{width:3.25rem;height:3.25rem}`.

tagline: mono? Tagline in serif italic feels nicer: font-style italic; color ink-soft; font-size 1rem; margin .35rem 0 0.

Grid masthead: grid-template-columns auto 1fr; column-gap 1.15rem; align-items center; avatar grid-row 1 / span 2. But if masthead on post page: title p row1, tagline row2 — same. Good. Ensure h1 margin 0.

Media query max-width 34rem: reduce avatar to 3rem, masthead padding-top 2rem, body font-size 1.03rem, main padding 0 1.1rem.

Also `.strip` font mono .72rem; text-transform uppercase; letter-spacing .1em; background paper-2; padding .55rem 1.1rem; gap; border-bottom 1px rule; border-top 3px accent; span color ink-soft. Links no underline, hover accent. Strip middle span may wrap on mobile — flex-wrap already; justify-content space-between fine. Maybe on small screens hide? No, leave visible; center span order fine.

Long words: overflow-wrap anywhere already in main.

Let me count words — should be well under 3000. Write it.

About markdown ~190 words.

Title: "Wide Margin". Tagline: "Notes from the space beside the text." Good.

Write final.
